content.value: A reinforced concrete foundation beam ABCD that supports a uniform load intensity q. If the maximum shear force and bending Moment are 2000 lb and 2800 lb-ft respectively, then determine the maximum load intensity q. Assume factor of safety for shear and bending moment are 2.5 and 3 respectively.
